audit_summary.summary: Most packet-bound factual claims are supported. The principal failures are unsupported directional transmission from a third-party memory-shortage story, two unverified sector-to-asset/ETF inferences, and deterministic stance/support defects in specialist horizon rows. Cross-role synthesis supports conditional technical views, with forward guidance, post-FOMC evidence, valuation, and issuer-specific transmission remaining critical gaps.
